name: SJTU Shanghai Government Scholarship / SJTU Scholarship (Class 1/2/3): English-taught Engineering Cluster / Global College (CS, Data Science, ECE)
provider: Shanghai Jiao Tong University + Shanghai Municipal Government
universities: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Global College, formerly UM-SJTU JI)
programmes: English-taught Engineering Cluster: Global College: Mechanical Eng., Electrical & Computer Eng., Data Science and Big Data Technology, Computer Science and Technology (Robotics planned); also Materials, Automation, CS (School of CS), Mechanical, Power & Energy. No pure mathematics or computational/molecular biology in English in the cluster.
covers_summary: Tuition: Class 1 100%; Class 2 50%; Class 3 25% (Engineering Cluster page 2027; main SJTU page for Chinese-taught programmes describes Class 3 as insurance + accommodation subsidy; discrepancy). Cluster tuition CNY 150,000/year. Stipend: Class 1 CNY 2,500/month. Housing subsidy CNY 1,100/month (Classes 1-2). Insurance included. Travel not covered. 4 years; annual review.
citizenship_restrictions: open to all: criterion is a foreign passport; GC: 'Non-Chinese citizens must hold a valid foreign passport'
residence_constraints: Not found; a residence permit in a third country has no effect (only a bank statement/financial certificate >= CNY 100,000 is needed).
age_limit: Not stated for SJTU scholarships; applicants under 18 on 1 September need a guardian in China.
language_required: English: TOEFL iBT 90 (until 21.01.2026) / 4.5 on the new scale, IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 120; a school English certificate is NOT accepted. HSK4 needed only by graduation (Chinese language and culture course).
tests_required: CSCA mandatory, with Mathematics (no other test substitutes); can be submitted by 30 June of the entry year. SAT/ACT optional (middle 50% of 2026 admits: SAT 1390-1500, Math 750-790).
what_it_takes: A-level Mathematics A or higher; IB Math HL 5+/SL 7+. Predicted A-level accepted but final scores must be provided. Transcripts of all schools. Common App + essay; 2 English recommendations advised. Ranking = academic results + interview. No separate form: tick 'Apply for scholarship' in the SJTU Portal application.
obligations: None found (no work-back or penalty in the texts). Not combinable with another scholarship.
numbers_awards: Not officially published. Press (wentchina.com, unofficial): Class 1 top 5%, Class 2 top 15%, Class 3 top 30% of applicants. Cluster tuition CNY 150,000/year (older ji.sjtu.edu.cn page: 120,000); housing subsidy elsewhere 1,000/month.
deadline_cycle: 2027 cycle: Early Action 1 Nov 2026, Regular 31 Mar 2027, decisions in January / July 2027; scholarship result with the admission offer (July). 2027/28 not published. Tuition prepayment within 2 weeks of the result.
online_school_recognition: Requirements for in-person/accredited schools not found on GC/Engineering Cluster pages; 'high school graduation or equivalent' and official transcripts are required; overseas schools are considered; a school English certificate is not accepted. Clarify by email to gc-admissions@sjtu.edu.cn.
covers_max: First-Class (4 yrs): tuition waiver (cluster tuition RMB 150,000/yr) + living allowance RMB 2,500/month + accommodation subsidy RMB 1,100/month + insurance RMB 800/yr; Second-Class: 50% tuition + accommodation subsidy + insurance; Third-Class: 25% tuition + insurance. ENGLISH-taught. (GC page: subsidy 1,000/month.)
req_grades: A-level Mathematics A or above; 'Predicted A-level or IB scores are accepted. Applicants are required to provide final scores for review.' Scholarship 'awarded based on the comprehensive ranking of applicant's academic and interview performance'; no cut-off published.
req_tests: CSCA 'Score with Mathematics is required'; may apply with SAT/A-level first, CSCA by 30 June of entry year ('cannot replace the CSCA requirement'). TOEFL 90 (old) / 4.5 (new), IELTS 6, Duolingo 120; school MOI not accepted. SAT optional: 2026 admits SAT 1390-1500, Math 750-790.
req_essays: Common Application (essay) first, then SJTU Portal
req_recommendations: Two required: high-school counselor + core academic teacher (en.sjtu page; GC page says 'recommended')
req_nomination: none: click 'Apply for scholarship' in SJTU online application; not combinable with other scholarships
req_documents: transcripts in English from all high schools ('special attention to mathematics, physics, chemistry'); passport >12 months; financial guarantee ≥ RMB 100,000; parents' nationality proof
req_deadline: 2027 admission: Early Action 1 Nov 2026 (decision by Jan 2027); Regular 31 Mar 2027 (decision by Jul 2027); results with admission.
recipient_profile: not published; unofficial press (wentchina.com, secondary): Class 1 top 5%, Class 2 top 15%, Class 3 top 30% of applicants
renewal_conditions: Period: 4 years (renewal criteria not published; GPA 3.0 only from unofficial press)
stackable: not combinable with another scholarship (previous check, October 2026)
online_school_ok: not stated: 'Graduation from high school or equivalent educational background'; pre-graduation certificate + diploma before enrolment. No in-person rule on either page.
